high_level_description: The image shows the back of a black T-shirt displayed on a mannequin torso. The T-shirt features a detailed and colorful graphic design of a cat's head and upper body. The cat is depicted with a side profile, facing to the left, and has a striking appearance with a mix of white and gray fur, accented by vibrant colors such as reds, blues, and yellows. The background of the design includes swirling patterns and floral elements, adding to the artistic and dynamic feel of the artwork.
